Title: KRAS gene status as a prognostic biomarker in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma: a retrospective cohort study.
Author: ['Zhang W', 'Ito T']
Affiliation: ['Department of Oncology, Example University Hospital, Wuhan, China.', 'Division of Hepatobiliary Surgery, Example Institute, Tokyo, Japan.']
Abstract: BACKGROUND: The role of KRAS status in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) prognosis remains debated. METHODS: We analysed 412 patients undergoing curative resection across two centres. RESULTS: Multivariate analysis identified elevated CA 19-9 as an independent predictor of poor overall survival (HR 2.1, 95% CI 1.4-3.2). CONCLUSIONS: KRAS status alone was not associated with survival in this cohort.
